_comment: address must be the full URL users add in F-Droid, ending in /fdroid/repo.
Leave it empty and the workflow derives https://<owner>.github.io/bdon-fdroid/fdroid/repo,
or set the REPO_URL repository variable to point at a custom domain.

repo.name: BanG Dream! Our Notes
repo.description: Official Android builds of BanG Dream! Our Notes, indexed straight from the publisher's website. The APKs are downloaded from the official bilibili CDN, not from this site.

app.name: BanG Dream! Our Notes
app.summary: GEKISO Gameplay x Adventure rhythm game
app.description: BanG Dream! Our Notes is a rhythm adventure game from Craft Egg and bilibili, featuring the bands MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica. This repository indexes the official English, Taiwanese, Hong Kong and Southeast Asian builds distributed on the publisher's own website; the APKs themselves are downloaded directly from bilibili's servers.

_comment: All of these are optional. Leave one empty to have it scraped from the official site.
iconUrl     - repository icon; defaults to the page's og:image (small, square).
appIconUrl  - the game's own icon; scraped from the site's image assets, because the page
has no apple-touch-icon and its only rel=icon is a 16px favicon.
screenshotUrls - pinned screenshots. The site's own images are content-hashed, so any URL
pasted here must be updated by hand when the site is redesigned.
